trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The iron spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Antimagic Susceptibility
entries: The iron spider is {@condition incapacitated} while in the area of an {@spell antimagic field}. If targeted by {@spell dispel magic}, the iron spider must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's spell save DC or fall {@condition unconscious} for 1 minute.

action.name: Web Cable
entries: The iron spider shoots out a 6-inch-thick web cable up to 50 feet long, attaching the far end of the cable to a solid surface up to 50 feet away from it. As a bonus action, it can detach the other end of the cable from itself and attach it to a solid surface within 10 feet of it. Once it creates 200 feet of web cable, the spider can't produce any more cable until the next dawn.
